officialEvidence.finding: Current recruitment section separately links notification 2979 at 10 October 2026 11:59 PM and notification 3062 at 15 October 2026 11:59 PM.

Ten-page scanned English notification 2979 invites one JJB-only application cycle for six tentative honorary social-worker positions, ₹2,000 per sitting, three-year term. Page 4 closes 10 October; Annexure A lists Giridih, Hazaribag, Pakur and Saraikela-Kharsawan.

Ten-page scanned English notification 3062 invites one district-specific application with JJB/CWC preference, four JJB and seven CWC tentative honorary openings, ₹2,000 per sitting and three-year term. Page 4 closes 15 October; Annexure A lists JJB vacancies in Dumka, Lohardaga, Sahibganj and Simdega, disjoint from notification 2979.

cycleIdentity: Two independent notification numbers, closing dates and district-disjoint JJB vacancy lists. Notification 3062 permits JJB/CWC preferences within one district application, so those role families do not inflate cycle count.
internationalApplicantAssessment: Neither notice states a nationality permission rule. Forms ask nationality and interview instructions ask for Aadhaar, which do not establish whether foreign citizens can apply or receive appointment. All stages need authority verification.
languageAssessment: Form asks for other languages known, if any. Neither notice prints a mandatory language or formal proficiency level; English document language is not converted into a requirement.
datePrecision: Portal prints 23:59 for both deadlines; PDF page 4 prints only closing date. Official governing timezone and opening date are not stated.
roleType: Honorary public appointment with sitting allowance; not salaried government employment.

excludedNotice.reason: Deoghar Home Guard advertisement 01/2026 page 1 expressly calls service volunteer membership paid only per duty day and says it is neither daily government employment nor a livelihood avenue. Excluded from government-job cycle counts.

access: Portal and three PDFs responded publicly. Portal robots.txt returned HTTP 404, so no disallow rules were served.
reviewNeeds: Founder resolves notification 2979 date/annexure mismatch, exact nationality and appointment rules, district form identity, eligibility alternatives and later amendments before approval.
